description:
FILED s535 (reviewing session, Opus 5.5, 2026-11-08) from the round companion-mover bisect (io/pipe.t 23/10 -> 31/12, 10 NEW `*extra*` rows on main).  SILENT WRONG: the program runs TWICE from that point on.

PERL (5.40.3): `open(P, "|    ")`, `open(P, "     |")` and `open(R, "-|", "")` -- a pipe open whose COMMAND is empty after the white space is dropped -- do NOT fork: they return undef with $! = EPIPE (32, "Broken pipe") and, under `use warnings` (category pipe), warn "Missing command in piped open at F line N." (doio.c checks the command before forking).

PCL (main ce665621): it FORKS, and the child -- whose exec of an empty command fails -- RETURNS from `open` and KEEPS RUNNING the rest of the program.  Probe (scratchpad pipe/p1.pl, the two opens inside `{ local *P; ... }` with `$| = 1` and a print of `$$` after each): perl prints before / r1=0 / r2=0 / after; PCL prints the tail of the file three times.  In io/pipe.t (lines 222-227) that makes every row after "missing command in piped open input/output" appear three times: the 10 `*extra*` rows.

HISTORY (probed on the merge trees): at MAIN-READY-65 (157f7255) the WRITE spelling `"|    "` already forked a running child (pre-existing); MAIN-READY-66 (70ff3112, s532a #4164 -- 2-arg open drops the white space around mode and name) widened it to the READ spelling `"     |"` as well (before, that open answered true without forking).  So: a pre-existing silent wrong whose reach a merge widened; it moved a companion baseline, so it jumps the queue.

FIX SHAPE: in the pipe-open path (the "|-" / "-|" arms reached from %p-open-parse-2arg and the 3-arg pipe modes), an empty command (after perl isSPACE trimming) returns false with $! = EPIPE BEFORE any fork, plus the announce of the warning under warnings-pipe if the runtime has the category machinery (else none -- the value is what matters).  ALSO check the belt: a child whose exec fails must `_exit` (perl: "Can't exec ..." on stderr, exit status 255 seen by the parent), never return into the program -- probe `open(P, "/no_such_process |")` (io/pipe.t row "child reaped if piped program cannot be executed" passes, so the non-empty path is probably right; confirm).

BAR: io/pipe.t back to 23/10 (or better) with 0 `*extra*` rows, one-file companion `tools/run-perl-suite.pl --jobs 1 io/pipe.t`; a guard row in Pl/t (both 2-arg spellings + the 3-arg "-|" with "", output printed once, $! == 32), inverse-verified on ce665621.  Runtime-only: corpus IDENTICAL; full sweep (cl/).
subject: A pipe open with an EMPTY command forks and the child keeps running the program (silent wrong; perl returns undef, $! = EPIPE, no fork)
